_about: One line per 30_Ressources technology folder, saying what belongs in it. Injected into the daemon's CLASSIFY prompt beside the folder names. This is data, not code (R6): the classifier holds the harness, the taxonomy lives here.
_provenance: Written 2026-08-28 after the first live drill of vault_daemon_e2e.py. The model was shown bare folder NAMES and put three notes in Docker, a two-note folder, including one about an outbox lock and one about a drop with no content at all: with nothing but a name to go on, a 9B model matches on surface association, and 'lock, daemon, container' reads as Docker. A folder absent from this file is still offered to the model, by name alone, so an unglossed folder degrades to the previous behaviour rather than disappearing.

folders.Docker: container images, Dockerfiles, devcontainers. Not the word for any daemon or background service.
folders.Git: git and GitHub: credentials, remotes, authentication, repository access.
folders.Graphify: the graphify knowledge graph: extraction, queries, updates, its output directory.
folders.LaTEX: LaTeX and BibTeX: document compilation, packages, markup, build output.
folders.Logiciel: retired catch-all. Never choose it; pick the real technology instead.
folders.Methode: a cross-cutting principle or working rule that belongs to no single technology.
folders.Obsidian: the vault itself: notes, wiki links, the Obsidian app and its CLI, the outbox write path, locks over the vault.
folders.Ollama: the local model daemon: model loading, VRAM residency, context window, KV cache, prompt caching, generation settings.
folders.PowerShell: the PowerShell language and its cmdlets, and Windows shell behaviour.
folders.Publication: journals, publishers, DOIs, reference metadata, figures and slides for papers.
folders.Python: the Python language and its standard library.
folders.ResearchTools: this toolkit: its skills, agents, hooks, installer, mirrors and test suite.
